checks.label: Duplicate payment verification
checks.detail: 499 high-confidence groups (£2.8M). Duplicate ratio: 0.1%. Filtered out: 6145 batch payments, 46502 CSV overlaps.

checks.label: Split payment analysis
checks.detail: 353 suspect instances (£55.2M, 3.3% of spend). Threshold: 5+ payments to same supplier in same week, 80%+ of approval limit.

checks.label: CH breach temporal verification
checks.detail: 5 suppliers with £390.8K confirmed during active breach periods. Enrichment errors excluded. Only dated violations with confirmed overlap flagged.

checks.label: Cross-council price comparison
checks.detail: 31 shared suppliers found. 18 with >200% price gap (requiring 3+ transactions each side). Extreme disparities (>10,000%) filtered as different service scopes.

checks.label: Benford's Law forensic screening
checks.detail: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). χ²=187057.65 on 443560 amounts >£100. Largest deviation: digit 1 (17.9% off expected).

warnings: 18 suppliers show >200% price disparity after filtering. These are more likely genuine value concerns than extreme outliers.
